// @path: src/lib/ops/operations.ts
// @expect: OPS-BANNED-IDENTIFIER
// @expect: OPS-MODEL-METHOD
// The near miss the rotation permission invites, and the reason it insists the
// value is minted inline.
//
// A code bound to a name is a code a later line can return, log or render, and
// the gate cannot follow it once it has a name. Here `fresh` reaches the
// caller, which hands the operator a working credential for that child's jar
// while every other rule in this file is satisfied. Inline minting makes the
// mistake unwritable rather than merely discouraged.
import "server-only";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { makeFamilyCode } from "@/lib/familyCodeMint";

export async function rotate(parentId) {
  const fresh = makeFamilyCode();
  await db.parent.update({
    where: { id: parentId },
    data: { familyCode: fresh },
    select: { id: true },
  });
  return { code: fresh };
}
